description: Pre-specified training configuration for the gated attention MIL head. Fixed from docs/ATTENTION_PLAN.md before any training on real labels; nothing here is tuned on validation results.
loss: cross-entropy weighted per slide by n_train / (3 * n_train_in_class)

gaussian_feature_noise.reason: fixed off a priori; choosing it on 6 validation slides would be tuning on noise

batch: one slide per optimiser step; slide order reshuffled each epoch
seed_selection_rule: highest validation macro-F1; ties broken by lowest validation loss, then lowest seed number. Applied by the Docker run (Phase 5); the native run only reports which seed it would pick.
metrics: lungcancer.modeling.metric_report (identical definitions to the saved logistic-regression model)
